name: 48316 · Shelby Twp, MI
findings: ZIP 48316 (Shelby Twp) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48316 (Shelby Twp) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48316 (Shelby Twp) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
